body.statement: For the fixed binary family in \(\mathrm{def:lag\text{-}switch\text{-}regression}\), the two models belong to the same \(\mathfrak M(H,1,\mathcal A)\), have exact common summary \(1\to2\), \(2\to1\), \(2\to3\), no bidirected edges, the same strictly positive entire stationary observed law as measures on \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\), and separately identifiable refinement-specific effects, but \(P_{M_0}(O_{3,0}=1\mid\operatorname{do}(O_{1,-1}=0))=13/50\) and \(P_{M_1}(O_{3,0}=1\mid\operatorname{do}(O_{1,-1}=0))=1/2\).
body.justification: This positive collision proves that per-refinement ID and formula enumeration are not complete for the uniform query.
